result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

Both are excellent, but they serve slightly different priorities: 1Password is particularly good for ease of use, while Bitwarden offers excellent value.

## My top 4 recommendations

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall for usability)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions
- Easy for non-technical employees
- Strong administrator controls
- Great for managing employee onboarding and offboarding

Business: approximately US\$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack: US\$24.95/month for 10 users.

[Official website](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

- Open-source software
- Secure shared collections
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Excellent value for growing teams

Approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Official website](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Business**

- Strong security and administrative controls
- Shared folders and delegated administration
- Good for businesses with stricter security requirements

Business Starter pricing starts around US\$2/user/month in some pricing regions.

[Official website](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach
- Secure sharing
- Good option for teams already using Proton products

Business pricing varies by plan.

[Official website](https://proton.me/business/pass)

These recommendations reflect published 2026 comparisons; verify current regional pricing before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/password-managers-built-teams/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritize for a small business

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it supports\:

- **Shared vaults\:** Employees can share company logins without sending passwords through email or Slack.
- **Individual accounts\:** Every employee has their own login.
- **Permission controls\:** Not everyone can access every password.
- **Easy offboarding\:** Revoke access immediately when someone leaves.
- **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
- **Audit logs\:** See who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the right solution rather than simply the most popular one.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

---

**2\. What does your business primarily use?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**

---

**4\. What passwords do you need to share?**
